test_override_virtual_functions: test overriding C++ virtual functions from Python subclasses using pybind11 trampoline classes
test_alias_delay_initialization: test that pybind11 trampoline classes are lazily initialized only when a Python subclass is created
test_move_support_noncopyable: test move semantics and non-copyable types when overriding virtual functions in Python subclasses
test_inherited_virtuals: test overriding inherited virtual functions across multiple levels of C++ class hierarchies from Python
test_python_override_cache: test that pybind11 correctly caches and resolves Python function overrides across repeated calls
